# WoodCutter

> WoodCutter is a Minecraft server plugin for Paper and Folia 1.21+ (Java 21+, basic Spigot support). It adds an axe enchantment: a player who sneaks and breaks one log with it cuts the whole tree. It has enchantment levels, two animations (layers, topple with physics), a woodcutting skill with perks, replanting, economy costs and rewards, PlaceholderAPI placeholders and integrations with WorldGuard, Vault, CoreProtect, Jobs, mcMMO and AuraSkills.

All settings live in `plugins/WoodCutter/config.yml` under `config:`. The main command is `/woodcutter` (aliases `/wcutter`, `/woodc`). Every page below is plain Markdown; the whole documentation in one file is at https://itsthechris07.github.io/WoodCutter/llms-full.txt
